title: Havana and Viñales: a fortified port city and a tobacco valley
goal: Describe Havana and the Viñales valley, adding your own stance with adverbs like lamentablemente and en rigor.
grammar: focus and stance adverbs like precisamente and francamente

items: I can show my attitude to a fact with stance adverbs such as *lamentablemente*, *francamente* and *en rigor*.
I can describe Old Havana and the Viñales valley.
I can use the new words for fortresses, limestone hills and tobacco fields.
